title: Complete C Programming Learning Roadmap - Coding Game Dataset
description: Syntax-to-output puzzle dataset covering a full practical C roadmap (40 parts), mirroring the structure of the Python/Java roadmaps but adapted to C idioms (pointers, structs, manual memory management, preprocessor macros, function pointers for OOP/callback patterns, pthreads, sockets, SQLite/libcurl C APIs, etc). Each item has a topic name, a syntax snippet, a fill-in-the-blank puzzle version, and the expected output. No theory, only practical runnable snippets, basic to advanced.
